spans.s:
मैनाक मैनाक, अस्, m. (fr. मेना), N. of a
mountain (son of Hima-vat by Menā or Menakā,
and said to have alone retained his wings when Indra
clipped those of the other mountains; according to
some this mountain was situated between the southern
point of the Indian peninsula and Laṅkā); N. of a
Daitya.
—मैनाक-स्वसृ, सा, f. ‘sister of Maināka,’
an epithet of Pārvatī.

मैनाल मैनाल or मैनिक, अस्, m. (fr.
मीन), a fisher, fisherman.
मैनेय मैनेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

मैन्द मैन्द, अस्, m., N. of an ape or
monkey-demon killed by Kṛṣṇa.
—मैन्द-मर्-
दन, अस्, or मैन्द-हन्, हा, m. ‘killer of
Mainda,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
